**AS91164 · external · E · 2025 paper**

**Location:** 2025 AS91164 examination paper, Question 2

> Carbon tetrabromide, CBr4 is an organic compound used in the manufacture of other organic compounds.
>
> **(b)** Explain why carbon tetrabromide is a liquid at room temperature.
>
> **(c)** Explain why carbon tetrabromide does not dissolve in water.
>
> **(d)** Explain why the molecule CBr3Cl is non-polar.
